newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Labs nasal spray gets FDA app.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Labs nasal spray gets FDA app.

text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc unit Wallace Laboratories said on Monday that it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Astelin nasal spray, which treats symptoms associated with seasonal allergic rhinitis.
Wallace said the prescription seasonal allergic rhinitis market was worth $1.5 billion and Astelin was the first prescription antihistamine spray for seasonal allergic rhinitis in the United States.
An estimated 20 to 40 million Americans suffered from seasonal allergic rhinitis, the company said.
